references: Joy Ang: Legends Darkstalker cover, facial anatomy only; depicts his youth, not ancient body scale
Talons of Power, chapter 1: at least three times the biggest full-grown dragons Turtle has seen
Escaping Peril pp285–286 and book-cited wiki: long twisted horns, black eyes, mountain-wide wing impression
Darkness of Dragons p344: very long neck; Talons of Power p54: white bone half-hoop in left ear

body.why: Retain the established S-curve spine and cranial attachment. Add mature deltoid/pectoral/haunch bulk and deeper trunk, with a smaller neck increase rather than a weak juvenile body enlarged uniformly.

horn.why: Long swept shafts with a restrained three-dimensional twist; keep seated skull-grown housings. Twist is visible in axis and longitudinal flutes, not bead-like rings.

physical_estimate.method: Ancient body scale = 3 times an explicitly assumed large-adult reference scale of 3.6 (same underlying NightWing unit convention). Adult reference is an art-direction estimate, not a canon size. No linear age-growth equation is used. Measured asset dimensions and speculative density-derived mass are exported separately.
physical_estimate.maturity_basis: Ancient dragon with roughly 2000 years of continued growth; not age divided by seven, and not three times the four-year-old Moon.

character_details.why: Talons of Power p54 and Legends Darkstalker p115; restrained pale details at the left ear and wing/body junction, not an IceWing-wide recolor.
